name: eeoom GEO – AI SEO
author: eeoom

sections.description:
Analyze and improve your WordPress site for AI search.

eeoom GEO is an AI SEO and Generative Engine Optimization plugin for WordPress that helps website owners analyze and improve their site for AI search. Important public pages can be opened through two clear workflows: Analyze page and Improve page.

The plugin combines AI search readiness checks, improvement ideas, real search signals, structured data and entity signals. It can help prepare content for ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity, but does not guarantee rankings, citations or mentions.

Analyze your WordPress site for AI search

Analyze page evaluates the current quality and machine-readable signals of a selected page. The available scores are internal readiness and quality indicators. They do not measure actual visibility in AI systems.

  • Structured Data checks structured data, entity relationships and other machine-readable signals.
  • Evidence Density evaluates concrete, useful information in relation to generic, interchangeable marketing language. It evaluates present content rather than penalizing missing topics.
  • Semantic Clarity evaluates how clearly the page’s main topic, important terms, services and relationships can be understood from its content.

Each analysis can provide a score, findings and recommendations. Audits are started manually, run independently and follow server-defined recheck periods.

Improve your WordPress site for AI search

Improve page turns page context and real search signals into practical editorial ideas. It does not automatically rewrite or publish content.

  • Customer Questions identifies relevant questions and needs around the selected page’s topic.
  • Content Opportunities turns demand into recommendations for strengthening the page or deciding where an idea may fit.

Content Opportunities can recommend actions such as:

  • Add as FAQ
  • Add as section
  • Add section + FAQ
  • Consider a dedicated page
  • Add or strengthen CTA

These are editorial options, not claims that a page or section is missing.

Search Signals

Customer Questions and Content Opportunities combine:

  • the content and context of the selected public page
  • page-specific Search Tags
  • real Google Autosuggest/Search Signals
  • AI-assisted filtering, clustering and interpretation

This helps identify what people are looking for and translate relevant demand into page-specific ideas. It does not provide search volumes, ranking data or measured AI visibility.

Schema & Entity

  • Add organization details and entity signals to supported structured-data output.
  • Map posts, pages and public custom post types to a Primary Entity.
  • Optionally use EntityPool entities, relationships and graph signals.
  • Add Full Graph, entity-specific Subgraph or saved Representation data where configured.

The graph integration complements supported schema output, including Yoast SEO. It does not require replacing an existing SEO plugin.

How it works

  1. Start with Analyze my homepage in the setup, or choose Analyze page or Improve page. The technical Suite connection is created if needed, without a separate visible Connect step.
  2. Select important published pages. The homepage is the first active page.
  3. Choose Analyze page for Structured Data, Evidence Density and Semantic Clarity.
  4. Choose Improve page for Customer Questions and Content Opportunities.
  5. Review results and choose relevant recommendations. Content is never changed automatically.
  6. Optionally configure Schema & Entity and connect EntityPool.

Before the first explicit user action that enables the Suite connection, no data is sent to the eeoom / Source of Trust platform. Plugin activation alone does not connect a new installation or start an audit. Authorized users start audits manually; they are not silently scheduled.

External Services / Privacy

No data is sent to Source of Trust before an authorized user first explicitly enables the Suite through an action such as Analyze my homepage, Analyze page or Improve page. Once connected, the existing connection is reused, including technical lifecycle updates when the plugin is deactivated or reactivated.

eeoom / Source of Trust platform

Source of Trust provides the Suite installation identity, active page records and manually initiated audits.

On connection, the plugin sends the public WordPress home URL, wordpress as platform information and standard request metadata to https://api.sourceoftrust.com. Returned installation credentials are stored locally for later requests.

After connection, requests may include credentials, public URLs, workspace/page identifiers, audit type, locale, lifecycle status and standard metadata. Source of Trust retrieves the selected public page for analysis. The plugin does not submit drafts, private content, preview URLs, passwords, visitor data or personal WordPress user data.

The plugin can register a WordPress-generated probe URL. Its opaque token returns only HTTP 204 when valid or HTTP 404 otherwise and exposes no account, entity, configuration, analysis or product data.

  • Service: https://sourceoftrust.com/
  • Production API: https://api.sourceoftrust.com/
  • Privacy Policy: https://sourceoftrust.com/en/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://sourceoftrust.com/en/terms

Source of Trust handles downstream processing on its servers. For AI-assisted audits, it may send normalized public page context, task instructions, locale and search signals to OpenAI. For Customer Questions and Content Opportunities, it may send search tags or query phrases plus language and market context to Google Autosuggest. The WordPress plugin makes no direct requests to OpenAI or Google. These downstream requests do not include WordPress credentials, private posts or visitor data.

Provider information: OpenAI Privacy Policy and Terms of Use; Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

EntityPool

EntityPool optionally provides centrally managed entities, relationships and graph representations. It is contacted only after an authorized user enters an integration key and uses it.

Requests may contain the integration key, entity or Representation identifiers and standard metadata. Returned graph data is cached locally. Post bodies, visitor data, passwords and WordPress user credentials are not sent.

  • Service: https://entitypool.com/
  • Privacy Policy: https://entitypool.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://entitypool.com/terms
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate eeoom GEO through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Follow the setup shown for a new installation, or open eeoom GEO in the WordPress administration.
  3. Choose Analyze my homepage, Analyze page or Improve page. This explicit action creates the technical Suite connection and page record if needed; no separate Connect step is required.
  4. Add further published pages as needed.
  5. Optional: Open Schema & Entity to configure local entity signals or connect EntityPool.
sections.faq:
What is eeoom GEO?

eeoom GEO is an AI SEO and Generative Engine Optimization plugin for WordPress. It analyzes pages, identifies improvement opportunities and strengthens entity signals for AI search.

What is AI SEO / GEO?

AI SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) help generative search systems understand content, entities and relationships. eeoom GEO provides readiness and improvement tools without promising rankings, citations or mentions.

What does Analyze do?

Analyze page runs Structured Data, Evidence Density and Semantic Clarity audits. Results can include scores, findings and recommendations. Scores are internal readiness indicators, not rankings or measured AI visibility.

What does Improve do?

Improve page combines page context with Search Tags, real search signals and AI-assisted interpretation to provide Customer Questions and Content Opportunities. No score audit is required first.

What are Customer Questions?

Customer Questions are relevant user needs identified from page context and related search signals. Unrelated results are filtered out.

What are Content Opportunities?

Content Opportunities turn search demand into editorial options such as an FAQ, section, dedicated page consideration or stronger call to action.

Does eeoom GEO measure AI visibility?

No. It evaluates page readiness and quality, not how often a site appears in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity or other AI systems.

Does eeoom GEO replace Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

No. eeoom GEO complements supported SEO and schema output. Its current direct graph integration supports Yoast SEO.

Does the plugin automatically change my content?

No. Editors choose which scores, findings, questions and opportunities to act on and make changes themselves.

What external services are used?

For Suite audits, WordPress communicates directly with the Source of Trust API. Source of Trust performs the analysis and may use OpenAI and Google Autosuggest on its servers; the plugin does not make direct requests to either provider. EntityPool is contacted separately only when its integration is enabled or used.
sections.changelog:
1.10.2

  • Adds a focused fullscreen setup for new installations with a first homepage analysis and three independent score rings.
  • Creates the technical Suite connection only when needed after an explicit user action, without a separate Connect step.
  • Allows setup to continue when some or all score checks fail, with clear result states and guidance.
  • Adds a calm completion screen with static results and a direct path to the page overview.
  • Fixes reactivation of existing Suite connections when setup is still pending.

For older changes, see changelog.txt.
